item.title: Middle East war: Oil tankers set ablaze in the Gulf in latest Iranian attacks
item.summary: Two #oil tankers were hit by Iranian explosives off the coast of #Iraq, as Tehran continues its blockade on the region. The attacks follow strikes in the Strait of #Hormuz, bringing up the number of #ships hit in the strategic passage point to at least 16.

item.title: Iran's new supreme leader to continue to keep Strait of Hormuz shut
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader, has declared in his first public statement read on state television Thursday, that he would keep the Strait of Hormuz shut to pressure the United States and Israel, as the war in the Middle East showed no signs of winding down.
